clauses.reason: This clause amends section 2 of Executive Order No. 11861 to place Defense Representative, Iran, Department of Defense, in level V in place of Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense (Comptroller). Section 2 of Executive Order 11976 states that section 2 of Executive Order No. 11861, as amended, "is further amended by deleting" the entry Defense Representative, Iran, Department of Defense, together with one other entry; the deleted wording matches the entry inserted here. No effective-date sentence appears in the held text of Executive Order 11976, so the date is its signing date, 1977-03-11. Later event: Executive Order 12076, signed 1978-08-18, revokes Executive Order No. 11861 as amended; that came after this entry was gone and is not the end.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text of Executive Order 11885, signed October 15, 1975, amends Executive Order No. 11861, as amended, which places positions in level V of the Executive Schedule, by deleting the entry Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense (Comptroller), Department of Defense, and inserting Defense Representative, Iran, Department of Defense. I read the whole order, a single paragraph; the representation is the machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF and page images were not inspected. End: Executive Order 11976, signed March 11, 1977 (42 FR 14081, issue of March 15, 1977), whose section 2 amends section 2 of Executive Order No. 11861 by deleting the exact entry this order inserted. The dossier chain lists Executive Order 11976 as an amendment of the parent; its section 2 removes the inserted position itself, so the inserted placement ends on that date. Executive Order 12076 later revokes the parent and is recorded as a later event. All other held amendments of Executive Order No. 11861 in the dossier chain were read and none touches the entry this order inserted.

savings.reason: Executive Order 11976 was read in full; it has two operative sections amending the lists of Executive Order No. 11861, no saving or transition clause and no effective-date sentence. Nothing in it continues the deleted placement.
